issues.title: e2e: make selected required checks and their evidence determine success
issues.body:
## Owner-approved scope reconciliation — 2026-09-27

Keep **v1.0.0-beta.165**, within #1134 work package C. The owner approved using this existing issue for the shared required-check evidence pattern, demonstrated by repairs to existing scenarios. Its original acceptance already allowed replacing the count with a signal every tier actually produces. No parallel assertion-accounting issue or broad E2E epic is created.

## Current evidence

The original claim that agentic never populates `AssertionsRun` is stale. At survey baseline `fe9482b7f336e575317cfb45fd1ad7c40baf7904`, it increments and cross-checks the count, but a stage returning nil can still mean the named check did not pass:

- [Agentic stage accounting](https://github.com/C360Studio/semstreams/blob/fe9482b7f336e575317cfb45fd1ad7c40baf7904/test/e2e/scenarios/agentic/scenario.go#L236) counts successful stage returns. [Tool/streaming metric checks](https://github.com/C360Studio/semstreams/blob/fe9482b7f336e575317cfb45fd1ad7c40baf7904/test/e2e/scenarios/agentic/scenario.go#L1060) can warning-skip failed observation; streaming can return success with zero chunks despite the configured streaming path.
- [Statistical search](https://github.com/C360Studio/semstreams/blob/fe9482b7f336e575317cfb45fd1ad7c40baf7904/test/e2e/scenarios/validate_search.go#L20) records query failures without failing the tier; the [final known-answer guard](https://github.com/C360Studio/semstreams/blob/fe9482b7f336e575317cfb45fd1ad7c40baf7904/test/e2e/scenarios/validate_search.go#L477) applies to semantic. Semantic also has independent hard checks, so this is not a claim that all semantic search failures pass.
- [Core dataflow](https://github.com/C360Studio/semstreams/blob/fe9482b7f336e575317cfb45fd1ad7c40baf7904/test/e2e/scenarios/core_dataflow.go#L265) can warn on content-validation failure. Its file-count minimum still fails missing output; those are different checks.
- Research assertion reporting still needs reconciliation. #1224 owns the direct-route false green, #1288 owns actual result-readback agreement, and #1195 owns throughput skip/response-validation failures.
- [`e2e:all`](https://github.com/C360Studio/semstreams/blob/fe9482b7f336e575317cfb45fd1ad7c40baf7904/Taskfile.yml#L209) selects five of thirteen container-backed tier families. A task name/dispatch guard proves selection resolves, not that every advertised or release-required tier ran. Thirteen available tiers are not automatically thirteen required tiers per PR.

These are source-review findings, not new runtime measurements. The earlier comments retain the count history; the agentic count check alone must not be copied as sufficient evidence.

## Bounded acceptance

- [ ] Inventory existing selector/task/dispatch and Result/TestRun writer surfaces before designing changes. Select and record explicit required suite membership, including intentional exclusions and measured cost; align task naming/help/docs. Unknown selections, zero required selections and missing selected required scenarios cannot produce a successful claimed run.
- [ ] Distinguish required checks, diagnostics and skipped work in the existing result/report path. Missing, failed or skipped required evidence prevents success and propagates to runner/task/job exit. Optional quality/profiler observations remain visibly diagnostic.
- [ ] Record actual completed behavioral checks, not nil stage returns. If a count remains, increment at real assertion points and verify the named required set; nonzero totals alone are insufficient.
- [ ] Repair representative existing agentic, graph/statistical and core checks above. Bind input/run/entity/loop identities to the expected consumer or terminal result; retain lower-level integration coverage rather than copying every race matrix into Docker.
- [ ] Demonstrate healthy controls and representative absent/wrong-result, observation-error and skipped-work controls. Show each defect makes the required check and outer runner fail, including the propagation path. Use deterministic fixtures; exercise real composition where that is the property at risk.
- [ ] Retain exact source/configuration and binary identity, command, selected/completed checks, outcomes and relevant artifacts, including failed runs, by extending existing writers and the release-candidate proof contract. An aggregate count or inaccessible scratch-log locator is insufficient on its own.
- [ ] Update `docs/contributing/01-testing.md` and `02-e2e-tests.md` with the implemented pattern and repaired examples; add one canonical reviewer/preflight pointer rather than duplicate rule prose across contracts. State precisely where scripted dependencies are used and what they prove.
- [ ] Use the normal OpenSpec change process before changing the harness acceptance contract. Specs describe the implemented behavior after landing; no standalone program document or new ADR is required merely for this work.

## Boundaries and sequencing

#1117 owns the beta.163 small-model semantic path gate; #769/#1128 own rc.1 agentic/CRUD assertions and CI selection. #1293 owns broader common local/CI verification, citation/fuzz/Go-coverage plumbing. Capability issues retain their own behavior and tests; this issue is not a second implementation owner for #1195/#1224/#1288.

Beta.163/164 membership is unchanged by this reconciliation. Where a current release's acceptance relies on one of the known false-positive checks, repair that required path in its owning work before citing it as proof; otherwise narrow the claim accurately. Do not pull the entire shared-contract migration into those tags.

Do not expand all tiers to full-run-per-PR, invent a new generic test framework, require model-quality thresholds without calibration, or add a fourth #1134 work package. Recheck live claims before touching shared harness/workflow files. Heavy local gates remain serialized; no paid model run is implied.
